row: Whispering Hearts Horse Rescue, Hagersville Ontario

Whispering Hearts Horse Rescue Center is a federally registered non-profit organization with charitable status.

Our mandate is 
To provide care and rehabilitation 
to abused and neglected horses. 
To assist members of the community 
that can no longer care for their horses 
in an attempt to prevent innocent animals 
being subjected to cruelty and neglect.

Our Goals and Objectives are:

Create a volunteer-based, equine welfare organization to ensure quality care and treatment of horses through intervention, education and outreach. 

Create a partnership to provide a reputable facility for the care and rehabilitation of horses under investigation.

Educate the public on equine welfare issues

Establish a program to assist other rescue organizations in Ontario as more facilities are needed to take in the increasing number of abused and neglected horses across the Province.
